description: This file contains socket utility functions for network operations, including address info retrieval, socket options configuration, address conversion, and comparison functions, specific to the ocudu project.

classes.name: sockaddr_storage_less
classes.description: Comparator class for sockaddr_storage objects, providing ordering based on address family, port, address, and scope ID.

methods.name: getnameinfo
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname and service name for a given socket address.

methods.name: get_nameinfo
methods.description: Returns a socket_name_info struct with IP address and port for a given socket address.

methods.name: bind_to_interface
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specific network interface.

methods.name: sockaddr_to_ip_str
methods.description: Converts a sockaddr to its string IP representation.

methods.name: sockaddr_to_port
methods.description: Extracts the port number from a sockaddr.

methods.name: set_receive_timeout
methods.description: Sets a receive timeout on a socket.

methods.name: set_non_blocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: sock_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts socket type constants to string representations.

methods.name: sockaddr_storage_equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two sockaddr_storage objects.

methods.name: sockaddr_storage_less
methods.description: Comparator for sockaddr_storage objects for ordering.
